description: Specification of the quantile-calibrated forward-collision-avoidance supervisor audited in this paper. Self-contained: requires no external paper.
B_sim_provenance: Calibrated boundary of the supervisor under audit: the (1-tau) quantile of simulator NORMAL-driving peak risk, averaged over calibration seeds. Reproducible from data/sim_calibration/sim_normal_peak_risk.csv via compute_B.py --recompute (agreement within 0.003).
